{"metadata":{"description":"Full-duplex voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness: mic → SenseVoice ASR (sherpa-onnx) → LLM → Edge TTS with true barge-in. 全双工语音插件：麦克风语音输入，SenseVoice 本地识别（简体中文+标点+ITN），流式 TTS 朗读，支持语音打断。Zero API key.","id":"gh:1335054027","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-voice","slug":"haoku123/dsh-voice","topics":["asr","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","sensevoice","sherpa-onnx","tts","voice","voice-mode"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Full-duplex voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness: mic → SenseVoice ASR (sherpa-onnx) → LLM → Edge TTS w"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ith true barge-in. 全双工语音插件：麦克风语音输入，SenseVoice 本地识别（简体中文+标点+ITN），流式 TTS 朗读，支持语音打断。Zero API key."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-voice"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Full-duplex voice mode for DeepSeek Harness: streamed ASR → LLM → TTS with barge-in."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Status"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**v0.8.2 — press-to-talk with a live caption.**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Speak into the composer mic: the assistant silences itself (playback stops,
host synthesis queue dro"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ps), the running turn is cancelled (the stop-button
route), and your speech is transcribed by the ho"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"st (SenseVoice, CN-native
simplified-Chinese ASR with punctuation + ITN) and submitted. The reply
st"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"reams back as spoken audio with live captions."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Three ways to dictate:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| gesture | behaviour |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| tap the mic | continuous dictation; the VAD segments on trailing silence |
| **hold the send key**"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" (or the mic) | records until release, slide up to discard |
| **hold `Ctrl`** (configurable `asr.ho"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"tkey`) | same, without leaving the keyboard; `Esc` discards |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"While a hold is open the overlay shows a **live caption** — the interim
transcript of what has been "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"said so far — and keeps a spinner up after
release until the authoritative transcript lands."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Barge-in detection is triggered by the mic's leading speech edge. The ASR
engine runs an **NLMS acou"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"stic echo canceller** (see `src/aec.ts`) using the
page's own TTS playback as the echo reference, so"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" loud assistant audio is
subtracted from the mic before the VAD — the browser-level
`echoCancellatio"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"n` constraint is kept only as a fallback when no echo
reference is available."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Live caption interims are **incremental**: each pass sends only the audio
recorded since the last pa"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ss (correlated by session header), and the host
decodes a bounded sliding window per session instead"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" of re-decoding the
whole hold. Preview cost therefore stops growing with hold length."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The loop: hold the composer's send key (its arrow is covered by a mic glyph),
watch the live caption"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" fill in while you speak, release into a spinner until
the final transcript lands, then the reply st"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"reams back as spoken audio
sentence-by-sentence — until the user's voice interrupts playback and sto"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ps
the running turn mid-line (true barge-in). `Ctrl` does the same without
leaving the keyboard."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- The `llm/stream` tap is **lossless**: every chunk is yielded unchanged, the
segmenter only observe"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"s. The model stream is never blocked by synthesis.
- ASR runs **host-side** with sherpa-onnx
(Apache"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"-2.0) running **SenseVoice** — the CN-native speech model that
outperforms whisper on Chinese: nativ"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"e simplified output, punctuation,
inverse text normalization (ITN) and 50+ language auto-detection. "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"The
browser only records and posts raw little-endian f32 PCM.
- Model files stream through a **cache"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"-through proxy** at
`/dsh-voice-api/hf` and are mirrored to disk
(`~/.cache/dsh-voice/models/`, conf"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"igurable via `cacheDir`), so every
browser/recognizer load after the first is served from local disk"},{"id":"p18s8","text":".
Downloads resume from partial `.part` files when interrupted. Use
`npm run prefetch` to warm the c"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"ache once.
- RMS endpoint detection: 16kHz getUserMedia, 2s trailing-silence cutoff,
max 30s segment"},{"id":"p18s10","text":", pre/post padding. Zero dependencies.
- **Press-to-talk bypasses the VAD entirely.** Holding the ke"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"y is already the
intent, so every buffer between press and release is kept — gating on
loudness ther"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"e only drops quiet speech, which is indistinguishable from a
broken button. Only captures below 250m"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"s are discarded (mis-taps).
- **Live caption**: while a hold is open the engine re-decodes the buffe"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"r
every ~900ms and shows the interim text. SenseVoice is not a streaming
model, so this is only requ"},{"id":"p18s15","text":"ested while the overlay is actually on screen,
and stops past 12s of audio. Interims are strictly pr"},{"id":"p18s16","text":"eviews: they never
reach the composer draft, and an interim that lands after the release is
dropped "},{"id":"p18s17","text":"(epoch check) so it can never overwrite the final transcript.
- Barge-in is three-layered: local pla"},{"id":"p18s18","text":"yback queue cleared, host `TtsQueue`
epoch bumped (queued AND in-flight synthesis dropped), and the "},{"id":"p18s19","text":"running
turn cancelled when `session.running` is true. An aborted turn never
flushes its trailing ha"},{"id":"p18s20","text":"lf-sentence — exactly what the user interrupted.
- `modelHost` accepts any HF-compatible mirror (e.g"},{"id":"p18s21","text":". `https://hf-mirror.com`
for CN networks)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## API"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Route | Purpose |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `GET /dsh-voice-api/stream` | SSE; `event: audio` frames `{sessionId, seq, text, audio(base64 MP3)"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"}` |
| `POST /dsh-voice-api/asr` | raw little-endian f32 PCM body → `{text}` via SenseVoice |
| `POS"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"T /dsh-voice-api/cancel` | `{sessionId}` drops queued + in-flight synthesis (epoch bump) |
| `GET /d"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"sh-voice-api/config` | ASR runtime config `{asr, basePath}`. Always served at this fixed path, so a "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"client can discover a custom `basePath` |
| `GET /dsh-voice-api/hf/*` | cache-through HF model proxy"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" (mirrors to `cacheDir`) |
| `GET /dsh-voice-api/*` | ping: `{ok, name, enabled}` |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Config (bundle patch row):"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Model files are fetched through the proxy on first use; warm the cache once
with the dsh host runnin"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"del files are fetched through the proxy on first use; warm the cache once
with the dsh host running:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Note: needs Node ≥ 22.19 or ≥ 24 (`node:zlib` zstd APIs). Works with dsh
0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.2.x — the "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` peer range covers both."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Tests"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":false}
